name: autocomplete
gotchas: mat-autocomplete renders nothing until it's connected to an input via `[matAutocomplete]` — the panel definition and the triggering input are two separate elements that must be wired together explicitly.
`displayWith` is required whenever option values are objects rather than primitives, or the input shows `[object Object]` after a selection instead of the intended label.
Filtering is entirely your own responsibility — MatAutocomplete does not filter `options` for you; subscribe to the control's `valueChanges` and recompute the filtered list yourself.
